messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara studies a map of the ruined royal city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hilltop overlook at dusk; ink-stained coat flapping, brass compass spinning toward distant broken spires.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp wakes with a warning.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of an oil lamp on a stone marker, single eye blooming in the flame, casting long shadows across cracked cobblestones.

scenes.caption: The tin fox sniffs out a hidden path.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes pawing at a half-buried sewer grate beside fallen royal banners.

scenes.caption: The glass diver arrives through a shattered window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet steps out of a tall broken windowpane, coat shimmering with reflected city fires.

scenes.caption: The team approaches the looming castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron gates twisted off their hinges, banners shredded; the four figures huddle in the rubble shadow at the threshold.

scenes.caption: Oracle lamp warns of the cursed tower ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning tower wreathed in green vapor; the lamp's flame-eye narrows, projecting warning glyphs onto Mara's outstretched map.

scenes.caption: Tin fox slips past an armored patrol.
scenes.visual_description: Empty enchanted suits of armor clattering along a courtyard; the metal fox darts between their boots, tail ticking softly.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks the archive door.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official slumped against a heavy oak door, ledger book as pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, snoring loudly.

scenes.caption: Mara forges a stamp to bypass the bureaucrat.
scenes.visual_description: Mara presses a hastily inked seal onto a fluttering paper while the official mumbles in his sleep, brass compass dangling.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a winged beast echo from the rooftops.
scenes.visual_description: Huge clawed shadow gliding across moonlit shattered rooftops; the team flattens against a chimney, tin fox's eyes glowing wary.

scenes.caption: Frightened townsfolk whisper from a barred window.
scenes.visual_description: Pale faces pressed behind iron bars in a basement window; Mara kneels to listen, lamp casting warm gold onto the cobbles.

scenes.caption: Glass diver swims through a stained-glass window.
scenes.visual_description: The rescuer dives headfirst into a cathedral window as if into water, colored shards rippling around the diving helmet.

scenes.caption: Inside the cursed tower, a magic door bars the way.
scenes.visual_description: A door inlaid with shifting silver runes; tin fox sniffs the seam while the lamp's eye projects a key-shaped beam.

scenes.caption: The captive is found within a mirrored cell.
scenes.visual_description: A small chamber lined with cracked mirrors; the glass diver reaches a gloved hand toward a trembling reflection that reaches back.

scenes.caption: Alarm bells ring as patrols converge.
scenes.visual_description: Empty armor clanging through smoke-filled halls; Mara waves the team into a side corridor, compass needle spinning wildly.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector trips up the pursuers.
scenes.visual_description: The dozing official tumbles from a doorway, ledger and papers flying into the path of clattering armored pursuers.

scenes.caption: They race across the cracking bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge over a glowing chasm, stones falling away behind their heels; lamp held high, tin fox sprinting ahead.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far cliff, the team looks back at the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn light over distant broken spires; the four rescuers stand on a windy bluff, banners of the dead city fluttering far below.
